name: Silvero Pereira
bio: Silvero Pereira (Mombaça, June 20, 1982) is a Brazilian actor and director. He has a degree in performing arts from the Federal Institute of Ceará.

credits.title: Beast Race
credits.overview: In future Rio de Janeiro, a young leader of the resistance must enter a deadly parkour-inspired competition in order to save his sister's life.

credits.title: The Night Forests
credits.overview: Jean encounters a psychic in the early hours of the morning. Sara attends Irene’s wake. Verônica plays a guerrilla fighter in a theater production. In the underworld of a metropolitan city center, fragments of love stories, delusions, and separations flicker throughout the night.

credits.title: The Park Maniac
credits.overview: An infamous serial killer who assaulted and killed several women in the '90s, gets on a collision course with a young journalist eager for the truth and a career-changing article.

credits.overview: Reporter Julião Siqueira, tired of being a joke at the station he works for, teams up with cameraman Yasmin to investigate a human trafficking complaint involving drag queen Lohanny and Nordrags agency. For this, the two will head into the world of Drag Queens.

credits.title: Belchior: Just a Wild Heart
credits.overview: Antonio Carlos Gomes Belchior Fontenelle Fernandes, or simply Belchior, in a self-portrait that plunges into the wild heart of the poet, singer and composer from Ceará, Brazil who, with his work and his cutting ideas, marked and still marks the lives of so many people.

credits.title: BR Trans
credits.overview: BR Trans is a documentary that gives voice to the most marginalized and murdered population in Brazil today: transsexuals. Through the juxtaposition of a play starring Silvero Pereira, real stories and fiction are mixed in search of feelings such as affection and empathy.​

credits.title: Neon Phantom
credits.overview: A delivery man dreams of having a motorcycle. He was told that everything would be like a musical film.

credits.title: Bacurau no Mapa
credits.overview: Behind the scenes of Bacurau (2019)'s shooting and pre-production. With exclusive images, directors Kléber Mendonça Filho and Juliano Dornelles show how they made the film an audience and critical success.

credits.title: Bacurau
credits.overview: Bacurau, a small town in the Brazilian sertão, mourns the loss of its matriarch, Carmelita, who lived to be 94. Days later, its inhabitants notice that their community has vanished from most maps.

credits.title: Copa 181

credits.overview: The year is 2020. And the fear we lived in 2015 came true: a religious dictatorship was installed in Brazil. But there is hope! In order to set us free, the travestites Shoshanna and Verônika depart on a high-risk mission.
